subject: Coord: Contract run-through & redline review (StrataCorp)
messages:
From: Emily Park <emily.park@stratacorp.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@stratacorp.com; James Wu <james.wu@stratacorp.com>
Date: 2027-02-14T09:22:00-05:00
Subject: Contract kickoff + redline run-through

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team liked the latency benchmarks. We're close on budget approval and would like to run through the current contract redlines so legal/procurement are aligned before we circulate an execution copy. Attached is our consolidated mark-up (pdf + comments).

Would your legal/AE team be able to do a 30–45 minute call next week to:
- walk through the outstanding clauses (data residency, audit logs, indemnity)
- confirm the SSO/KMS security requirements and timeline
- surface anything that would change scope or pricing

Our rough availability: Tue 2/16 10–12 ET, Wed 2/17 14–16 ET; if those don't work we can be flexible.

Attachments: StrataCorp_Redline_v3.docx (track changes), summary-redlines.pdf

Thanks,
Emily Park
Procurement Lead, StrataCorp
emily.park@stratacorp.com
+1 (617) 555-0119

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Emily Park <emily.park@stratacorp.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-14T11:10:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Contract kickoff + redline run-through

Hi Emily — great to hear, and glad the demo landed.

I'm looping in Laura (legal) and Ben (AE) so we can coordinate a focused session. Laura, Ben — can you review the attached from Strata and confirm if 30 minutes is enough to cover the gaps Emily mentions? We can also add Marcus for any post-signature onboarding notes.

Proposed slots (ET):
- Tue 2/16 10:30–11:00
- Tue 2/16 11:30–12:00
- Wed 2/17 14:00–14:45

If none work, share alternate windows and we'll find one. I'll prepare Redwood's redline doc and a short agenda:
1) Data residency & retention
2) Audit logs & access controls
3) Indemnity & liability cap
4) Operational onboarding items (SSO, KMS, audit artifacts)

I've attached our response draft.

Attachments: Redwood_Response_v1.docx

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Date: 2027-02-15T08:43:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Contract kickoff + redline run-through

Grace / team — thanks for the quick reply. Our legal team is tied up during the Tue morning window. Two options that would work on our side:
- Tue 2/16 16:00–16:30 ET (short window, fine if you can do a quick run)
- Wed 2/17 14:00–14:45 ET (best option)

Also quick ask from procurement: before the redline session can we have a 15-min sync to confirm SSO and KMS scoping so we don't conflate contract language with implementation details? That would just include Grace + Marcus + our infra lead (copied on separate note).

We'd prefer receiving both your redline and a summary of proposed changes in advance so our counsel can prioritize. We attached a high-level checklist in the prior note.

Thanks — happy to confirm a calendar invite once you pick a slot.

- James
James Wu
Sr. Counsel, StrataCorp
james.wu@stratacorp.com

Subject: Re: Contract kickoff + redline run-through

Thanks all — Wed 2/17 14:00–14:45 ET works for Redwood legal and AE. I'll take the lead on the review; proposed agenda below.

Agenda (30–45m):
- 5m: Introductions & scope (who signs what)
- 10m: Data residency, retention, and audit log obligations
- 10m: Indemnity, liability cap, and termination rights
- 5–10m: Implementation handoff items (SSO/KMS timeline, proof points)

Please send the final markup and a 1–page summary of your top 5 asks before EOD tomorrow so we can triage comments.

Attachments: discussion-points-redwood.pdf

I'll go ahead and schedule the invite for Wed 2/17 14:00–14:45 ET and include a brief pre-read link. If anyone needs to shorten to 30 minutes, let me know.
